title: QUIC RFC 9000 S13 Periodic ACK-Probe Scheduling Verification
verification_method: Focused requirement-home tests over the active-path recovery PING probe and application-send delay boundary, plus the ACK piggyback policy benchmark harness, coverage triage regeneration, SpecTrace JSON validation, and diff checking.
scope: This verification covers the supported active-path Application Data floor for bounded small-packet send delay and periodic ack-eliciting PING probes when recovery has no retransmittable payload to send.
expected_result: Focused tests show small writes can be coalesced after the short delay, the threshold edge sends without arming the delay timer, the recovery PTO fallback sends PING as a non-PADDING ack-eliciting probe, the probe is not retransmittable, a later recovery expiration can send another PING probe, and the probe path remains unavailable without active-path and 1-RTT prerequisites.
procedure: Run the focused S13P2P7, S13-0002, and adjacent S13P2P1-0009 requirement-home filter.
Run the ACK piggyback policy benchmark harness with the Dry job.
Run the ACK piggyback policy benchmark harness with the Short job if local time permits.
Validate canonical SpecTrace JSON with the core profile.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
Run the full Release build and full Release no-build test suite.
preconditions: The runtime has an active path and 1-RTT packet protection material before an Application Data PING probe can be sent.
Recovery has no retransmittable payload or queued application send available before falling back to PING.
Application stream writes below the small-packet threshold are eligible for the bounded send delay.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim candidate-path or multipath send scheduling, general packet-composition completeness, PMTU behavior, hosted interop success, or public API changes.

status_summary: Local verification passed for this closure: focused S13 requirement-home filter 9/9, ACK piggyback policy Dry and Short benchmark jobs 5/5 each, SpecTrace core validation 508 artifacts, Release build 0 warnings/errors, full Release no-build suite 4,830/4,830, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, and git diff --check with only generated-triage CRLF normalization warnings.
